v1.0.0-alpha.description: Initial release; a rough draft/Minimum Working Example of the mod.
v1.0.0-alpha.title: First alpha version/MWE

v1.0.0-alpha1.description:
Changes of note for this release:
- The client can now remember received items while disconnected and closed, and remember checks to send next time connection is restored.
- The client will no longer attempt to send checks multiple times if completed multiple times (unsure if this was having any effect, but better safe than sorry).
- The client now causes the game to use an alternate save file location while installed. You can add a suffix to this file via the mod's BepInEx config file, e.g. for participating in multiple Archipelago runs at once.
- The Bonus Gill filler item now has an implemented effect ingame. Traps are still NYI.
- Fixed an issue causing the game to crash/stall on close while the client is installed.
- Fixed an incorrect plugin GUID on the client.
v1.0.0-alpha1.title: v1.0.0-alpha1: offline safety, separate save file, working filler

v1.0.0-alpha2.description:
- Fixed goals not being sent (I really didn't understand what the victory event pattern was for...)
- Fixed boss region not unlocking after obtaining the relevant region item
- Added a tool to generate zipped apworld files automatically (no more manual file shuffling! or at least less of it!)
- Added some extra debug tools
v1.0.0-alpha2.title: v1.0.0-alpha2: goals hotfix

v1.0.0-alpha3.description: Traps are here! Also significant backend improvements and tidying, new options for check categories, implementation of the Endless Mode and Final Boss Key items, a fix for incorrect region assignments, prettier Skigill node disabling, and more.
v1.0.0-alpha3.title: v1.0.0-alpha3: traps and check options galore

v1.0.0-beta.description:
This update introduces custom-sprited UI for the client plugin, including a built-in location tracker and item send/receive notifications! Also includes A LOT of bugfixes (including one possible vanilla bug), Death Link improvements, and more.

Full changelog: https://github.com/ThinkInvis/Archskipelagill/blob/main/changelog.md#100-beta
v1.0.0-beta.title: v1.0.0-beta: the HUDening

v1.0.0-beta1.description:
After my first run of this mod in a production setting, here's a hotfix for some issues I noticed. Most notably, the game should no longer freeze for a short time while performing a check, and the final boss node will now unlock immediately if the Final Boss Key item is received mid-run.

This release makes no changes to the APWorld file; an old copy may be used without issue.
v1.0.0-beta1.title: v1.0.0-beta1: live run tested

v1.0.0-beta2.description:
This update introduces randomized weapon pool and starting region! Also includes new check categories, better trap configurability and balance, a few UX tweaks, a major client refactor, and more.

Full changelog: https://github.com/ThinkInvis/Archskipelagill/blob/main/changelog.md#100-beta2
